source: PUB Code of Practice on Surface Water Drainage, 7th Edition (Dec 2018) with amendments under Addendum No. 3 (April 2025), Appendix 4 'Rainfall Intensity-Duration-Frequency Curves for Singapore Island', printed page 49 (PDF page 68)
method: piecewise log-axis calibration on detected grid lines; column-wise tracking of the 8 curves (runs 2-6 px tall, grid-line bands masked); intensity at each tabulated duration from a local linear fit of traced points within +-8..45 px after rejecting points >1.5 px off a local line
